scripts.rdf:deps: python -c "import rdflib" || python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input -r requirements-rdf.txt
scripts.prepare:generated: npm run rdf:deps && npm run rdf:generate && npm run generate
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:generated && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.check: npm run prepare:generated && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check --minimumFailingSeverity warning
scripts.build: npm run prepare:generated && npm run validate:source && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs && node scripts/validate-dist.mjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run prepare:generated && npm run validate:source && npm run validate:media && npm run validate:evidence && npm run validate:shacl && npm run validate:reproducibility
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run validate:media && npm run validate:evidence && npm run validate:shacl && npm run validate:reproducibility && node scripts/package-dist.mjs
